notes.title: Update Version 2.2.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just here to tell you that we've dropped Version 2.2.2!

This should hopefully fix some issues with achievements not being registered (you should retroactively earn any when you start the game), and keybindings not being saved. Hopefully. Plus, a few other minor fixes.

If you still have any issues with this new version, please let us know, and we'll try to fix them ASAP.

Thanks, and Happy Blasting!

If you notice any more issues or have any questions or comments, please let us know! We love to hear from you.

notes.title: UPDATE! Minor Changes + New Unlockable Playable Character!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25925263/bda422adb25f31a8711b7dc0e6deee534e165ddd.png[/img]

Axol Studio is pleased to announce that the update to Blasting Agent: Ultimate Edition is finally here!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*][h1]Boss Rush Challenge![/h1]
Finish the game on Hard Difficulty to unlock this mode which pits you against each boss in the game back-to-back!
You earn upgrades during the run when you defeat a boss, and dying respawns you on the same boss.
You can choose to play Boss Rush on either Normal or Hard mode.
How quickly can you defeat them all?

[*][h1]New Playable Character: Sting![/h1]
Beat the game on Normal mode, and you will unlock Special Tactical Agent Codename: Sting!

Sting is a martial arts expert: faster, more agile, and can jump higher than the Blasting Agent. She uses powerful attacks up-close and personal to her foes, including punches, kicks, dive kicks, and mid-air spin kicks.

Note that Sting plays a LOT differently from the Blasting Agent character. Although she is much more maneuverable, she has no ranged attacks, and some of the bosses are VERY challenging to defeat as Sting.
She also cannot collect or use any upgrades (she can still earn them by collecting gold and defeating enemies, but only the Blasting Agent can use them). However, she can be useful in locating hidden upgrades to come back with the Blasting Agent to collect later on.

There are no extra rewards for beating the game as Sting - she's just a fun, and challenging character to play as.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed problem with keybindings
[*]Fixed issues with enemy AI logic
[*]Changes to special effects logic to enhance performance
[*]Minor tweaks to some rooms and levels to fix issues.
[/list]

If you already own the game on Steam, you should be seeing the update already!  If you got the game from somewhere else, check to see if you can download it yet.

The update is planned to release on Wii U and Nintendo 3DS soon.

notes.title: Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm just letting you know that an update is in the works!

I've been working on the game pretty much since launch day, trying to find ways to improve and add to the experience.

So far, some of the changes that are coming include:

[list]
 [*] Tweaks and Improvements to some of the special effects graphics that should help with performance.
 [*] Tweaks to enemy AI - some of the enemies weren't acting properly, and some were acting a little [i]too[/i] well...
 [*] Minor Tweaks to problematic rooms and doors not connecting properly
 [*] Bug fixes, including the problem with keybindings 
 [*] An all new (unlockable) game mode: Boss Rush! Beat the game once to be able to take on each boss back-to-back and compete for the best time!
 [*] ...and one more surprise, that I'll be talking about a little later! ;)
[/list]

This update has a little more work left to go until it's ready, and then it needs to pass some QA testing. The plan is to release it on Steam and on all the other platforms at the same time.

I'll be back later on with more details about that secret item, and maybe some more news besides that...
 
 Thanks!
